how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-the-barrens-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:819:obj:0: Find someone who knows about Chen's Empty Keg.
rows.quest:819:details:0: A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says,
rows.quest:819:details:2: BMay your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."
rows.quest:819:completion:1: BThis was one of Chen Stormstout's kegs. He traveled with Rexxar a long time ago. I haven't seen or heard about him in a kodo's age. I appreciate you bringing this to me, ⟦1⟧.
rows.quest:821:obj:0: Bring 5 Savannah Lion Tusks, 5 Plainstrider Kidneys, and 1 Thunder Lizard Horn to Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet.
rows.quest:821:details:0: Would you like a taste of Chen's namesake? Ahh, the stormstout is a mighty brew. Chen taught the recipe to my mentor, and my mentor passed it on to me. I'll need you to get me a few things, but I can tell you this: the kick is worth it.
rows.quest:821:details:1: BBring me 5 savannah lion tusks from any savannah lion, 5 plainstrider kidneys from any plainstrider, and 1 thunder lizard horn from any species of thunder lizard. That should do the trick nicely.
rows.quest:821:details:2: BYou can find these ingredients throughout the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:821:completion:0: Haha... I never thought I'd make more of this stuff ever again.
rows.quest:821:completion:1: BYou've stirred in me a great sense of nostalgia, ⟦2⟧. Kind of reminds me of the last time I blacked out from too much trogg ale. Thank you. The memories warm my stomach.
rows.quest:843:obj:0: Gann Stonespire wants you to kill 15 Bael'dun Excavators and 5 Bael'dun Foremen.
rows.quest:843:obj:1: BBring Khazgorm's Journal to Gann Stonespire.
rows.quest:843:details:0: In solitude I wander these roads.
rows.quest:843:details:1: BThe dwarves of Bael Modan show no respect for my land. Horrendous blasts drive holes deep into the ground as noisy machines rip apart the hills. Lands which once served as home and provider to my tribe are now riddled with destructive dwarves.
rows.quest:843:details:2: BAttempts at reaching a diplomatic resolution have failed. Now is the time for decisive action.
rows.quest:843:details:3: BDrive the dwarves from the Bael Modan excavation by force and bring to me the journal of their leader, Prospector Khazgorm.
rows.quest:843:completion:0: Khazgorm met the fate he earned. I feel no remorse for the fool. He was an infidel on these lands.
rows.quest:843:completion:1: BMay his death serve as a warning to all those who threaten to disrupt our way of life.
rows.quest:843:completion:2: BNow let me take a moment to study the dwarf's journal....
rows.quest:844:obj:0: Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks and return them to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:844:details:0: Your first prey will be easy.
rows.quest:844:details:1: BThe plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance.
rows.quest:844:details:2: BPut down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.
rows.quest:844:completion:0: Very good, ⟦3⟧. With the plainstriders gone we'll have an easier time keeping our supply chains intact. And I hope you learned a few tricks out there in the ⟦E1⟧, for your next prey has a little more fire in its blood than the plainstriders...
rows.quest:845:obj:0: Slay Zhevra Runners to collect 4 Zhevra Hooves for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:845:details:0: The zhevra, although not the fiercest beast in the ⟦E1⟧, are a shade tougher than the plainstriders. Don't worry -- we'll send you against bigger prey in good time, but for now your teeth could use a little more cutting.
rows.quest:845:details:1: BHunt the zhevra to the north and south, and collect their hooves. Bring them to me and perhaps we'll next send you against something tougher.
rows.quest:845:completion:0: Not bad, ⟦4⟧. Those zhevra hold a lot of strength in their legs. A sharp kick from them can knock even a tauren on its haunches!
rows.quest:845:completion:1: BIt looks like you have some strength in you too. Are you ready for a real challenge?
rows.quest:846:obj:0: Gann Stonespire wants you to bring him 6 vials of Nitroglycerin, 6 bundles of Wood Pulp, and 6 samples of Sodium Nitrate.
rows.quest:846:details:0: It is clear the prospector depended on explosives and those noisy vehicles to rip the ground apart. We can expect a new foreman to take over soon.
rows.quest:846:details:1: BI want to give the dwarves a taste of their own medicine. According to these plans if we combine nitroglycerin with wood pulp and sodium nitrate we can create an explosive charge. The rifleman, soldiers and officers in the Keep are known to have the supplies.
rows.quest:846:details:2: BCollect these items and bring them to me. I will fashion a charge that the dwarves won't forget!
rows.quest:846:completion:0: I see you are quite industrious, ⟦5⟧.
rows.quest:846:completion:1: BNo doubt we shall soon have a fitting surprise for those dwarves.
rows.quest:848:obj:0: Bring 4 Fungal Spores to Apothecary Helbrim at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:848:details:0: The oases of the ⟦E1⟧ hide a mystery. Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it.
rows.quest:848:details:2: BThere is a mushroom that grows near these oases. Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful.
rows.quest:848:details:3: BBring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
rows.quest:848:completion:0: Ah, yes. These are good specimens. Potent.
rows.quest:848:completion:1: BI am ⟦E2⟧, and we honor our contracts. Here is your reward, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:849:obj:0: Destroy the flying machine at Bael Modan and return to Gann Stonespire.
rows.quest:849:details:0: Following Khazgorm's plans it should be no problem to fashion an explosive charge
rows.quest:849:details:2: BNow, ⟦7⟧, I am going to entrust you with a special task. Take this explosive stick and use it to blow up the flying machine at Bael Modan.
rows.quest:849:details:3: BNot only is the flying machine a key part of the site's infrastructure it also serves as a weapon of war. More importantly it is an icon of power and an insult to the memory of my tribe.
rows.quest:849:details:4: BMake me proud by completing this heroic task and you shall be rewarded.
rows.quest:849:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦8⟧! May you be revered in ⟦E3⟧ as a defender of sacred tauren lands and a champion of the lost tribe.
rows.quest:850:obj:0: Bring Barak's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
rows.quest:850:details:0: The centaurs have plagued the Tauren for years. And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the ⟦E1⟧ have grown into a real threat. Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them. Rallying them.
rows.quest:850:details:1: BTo preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed.
rows.quest:850:details:2: BBring me the head of Barak Kodobane. He camps near the Forgotten Pools to the north.
rows.quest:850:details:3: BDefeat him, then return to me.
rows.quest:850:completion:0: Well done, ⟦9⟧. The centaur are low, brutish creatures, but a few have the wit and vision to lead. And those are the most dangerous.
rows.quest:850:completion:1: BBarak was such a centaur. It is good that he is dead.
rows.quest:851:obj:0: Bring Verog's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
rows.quest:851:details:0: The centaur Verog the Dervish wanders the ⟦E1⟧, and will be difficult to find. But he is based at the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast. It may be possible to draw him to you.
rows.quest:851:details:1: BTravel to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast and attack centaur near the command tent. It will be dangerous, but if you can kill enough centaur then they should raise an alarm. And Verog will come.
rows.quest:851:details:2: BBring me his head and I will place it with Barak Kodobane's.
rows.quest:851:completion:0: Very good. You must have really stirred up those centaur -- our guards spotted activity down near the Stagnant Oasis, which was probably you.
rows.quest:851:completion:1: BYou should be proud of your deed, ⟦10⟧. There is much bravery in you.
rows.quest:852:obj:0: Bring Hezrul's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
rows.quest:852:details:0: Hezrul Bloodmark is the leader of the Kolkar centaurs in the ⟦E1⟧. He is fierce, brutal and cunning. Defeating him would disrupt and fracture the Kolkars, greatly reducing their threat to us.
rows.quest:852:details:1: BSo kill him. As with Barak and Verog, bring me Hezrul's Head.
rows.quest:852:details:2: BHe leads his people from the Lushwater Oasis, to the south.
rows.quest:852:completion:0: I commend you, ⟦11⟧. These centaur are undisciplined and cannot focus their rage as the orcs can, but they are fierce nonetheless. In defeating them, your valor is proven.
rows.quest:853:obj:0: Bring the Rendered Spores to Apothecary Zamah in ⟦E3⟧, before the time limit is up.
rows.quest:853:details:0: I have rendered the spores you gave me into an emulsion. I must now send it to my associate, Apothecary Zamah. If you were to carry this to her, she can offer you something from our stores of alchemical goods.
rows.quest:853:details:1: BShe is in the Pools of Vision, a cave beneath the shamans of ⟦E3⟧. The path to this cave is well hidden, but you may find it on the Spirit Rise bluff.
rows.quest:853:details:2: BDo hurry. This emulsion will maintain its potency for only a short time, and must be resealed and processed before then.
rows.quest:853:completion:0: Ah, the spores from the ⟦E1⟧ that Helbrim was gathering. He garnered your aid in delivering them? Good.
rows.quest:853:completion:1: BAnd the emulsion is still potent, so you must have wasted no time in the delivery. Well done, ⟦12⟧.
rows.quest:855:obj:0: Bring 15 Centaur Bracers to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.
rows.quest:855:details:0: The Kolkar are a threat to the ⟦E4⟧'s claims in the ⟦E1⟧; we must reduce the numbers of their troops. And so, I have a bounty task for you.
rows.quest:855:details:1: BWhile in Kolkar territories, slay their warriors and collect centaur bracers. Return when you have a heap of bracers and the ⟦E4⟧ will reward you well.
rows.quest:855:completion:0: Nicely done. I'm sure you've struck fear into the surviving centaurs, ⟦13⟧. If they have sense, they'll now calm themselves and stop their advances.
rows.quest:855:completion:1: BBut I don't think they will, and that is unfortunate.
rows.quest:857:obj:0: Feegly the Exiled wants you to retrieve for him the Tear of the Moons.
rows.quest:857:details:0: The power was mine! In my very hands! And I want it back! Back I say!
rows.quest:857:details:1: BThose dirty excavators uncovered it... so beautiful it was. Deemed the Tear of the Moons, it was the first great discovery we made at Bael Modan.
rows.quest:857:details:2: BIt should have been mine! Mine I say!
rows.quest:857:details:3: BGeneral Twinbraid grew jealous of the power it gave me. He locked it away in the Keep. Called it cursed, he did! The fool!
rows.quest:857:details:4: BOthers wanted it and they had to be stopped! That bastard Twinbraid drove me off.
rows.quest:857:details:5: BNow I want it back. Back I say!
rows.quest:857:completion:0: At last, the power is mine again! Mine I say!
rows.quest:858:obj:0: Get the Ignition Key and bring it to Wizzlecrank.
rows.quest:858:details:0: I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.
rows.quest:858:details:1: BWe need to get out of here on the double! Go up to the control room at the top of the derrick, the supervisor should have a key for this shredder.
rows.quest:858:completion:0: Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing...
rows.quest:858:completion:1: BHmm... rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... fine arm movement control. Just look at this! I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. I've got to get this back to Ratchet!
rows.quest:860:obj:0: Speak with Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:860:details:0: If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the ⟦E1⟧. Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce. You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.
rows.quest:860:details:1: BSpeak with Sergra Darkthorn. She will be your first guide in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:860:details:2: BSergra is at the Crossroads. To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the ⟦E1⟧, then north as the road forks. And have care as you travel--the ⟦E1⟧ holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.
rows.quest:860:completion:0: You want to hunt in the ⟦E1⟧?
rows.quest:860:completion:1: BYour eyes are eager, and young. They're not yet squinted from tracking your prey across this land's dry plains.
rows.quest:860:completion:2: BBut worry not. We'll toughen your body and your mind. And we'll teach you that there is more to hunting than finding and killing your quarry.
rows.quest:860:completion:3: BPrepare yourself. Your journey begins. Now.
rows.quest:863:obj:0: Protect Wizzlecrank and the stolen goblin shredder on the way to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
rows.quest:863:details:0: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?
rows.quest:863:completion:0: Hopefully we'll be able to get something of value from the wrecked shredder prototype... my time's running out! I'll dispatch a salvage team to Wizzlecrank's location on the double.
rows.quest:863:completion:1: BOh, let me give you something for your trouble, too.
rows.quest:865:obj:0: Gather 5 Intact ⟦E5⟧ Horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, and bring them to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
rows.quest:865:details:0: The raptors of the ⟦E1⟧ are smarter than raptors in other lands. And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns! If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks." I could sell them for a fortune!!!
rows.quest:865:details:1: BAnd you can help me. Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws. They roam in the southern ⟦E1⟧, and in the northern ⟦E1⟧ near the border of ⟦E6⟧ Forest.
rows.quest:865:completion:0: Great, you got them! Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
rows.quest:867:obj:1: BReturn them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:867:details:0: The blasted harpies have been ravaging our caravan supplies for too long. It's time we slit a few of their throats and diminished their numbers.
rows.quest:867:details:1: BI've been snooping around their nests and figured out who leads who. The most devastating attack will destroy a good section of their lower chain of command and then we can work our way to the top.
rows.quest:867:details:2: BI'll start you off slow, take out Witchwing Harpies and Witchwing Roguefeathers in the Northwest and bring me 8 Witchwing talons. That should be a good start...
rows.quest:867:completion:0: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, ⟦14⟧. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
rows.quest:868:obj:0: Bring 12 Silithid Eggs and the Digging ⟦E7⟧ to Korran at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:868:details:0: Hey, ⟦15⟧. I been sent to the Crossroads to watch over the land and take note of its happenings for my masters in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:868:details:1: BOne object of my studies are the insect-like creatures found to the south in the Field of Giants. We know little of the creatures, so I be makin' it a point to discover more. They seem to have intelligence to them, more so than any normal animal.
rows.quest:868:details:2: BTake this digging claw and collect some of the creatures' eggs from their mounds, but be careful: if alerted, they will attack you.
rows.quest:868:completion:0: You please me, ⟦16⟧. The eggs and the tool. Well done.
rows.quest:869:obj:0: Bring 12 ⟦E5⟧ Heads to Gazrog at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:869:details:0: Not long ago, a shipment of silver was stolen from our guard tower. It was meant as payroll to the Crossroads' guards, and we want that silver back.
rows.quest:869:details:1: BThe strange thing is... we caught one of the thieves on the night of the theft. And... it was a raptor! Unbelievable!
rows.quest:869:details:2: BI don't know what raptors would want with silver. But I don't care -- I want the raptors dead so they won't steal from us again!
rows.quest:869:details:3: BHunt raptors in the ⟦E1⟧. Collect for me their heads!
rows.quest:869:completion:0: You got rid of the raptors!
rows.quest:869:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦17⟧. You are a ⟦18⟧ of worth.
rows.quest:870:obj:0: Report back to Tonga Runetotem with your findings.
rows.quest:870:details:0: Long ago, the ⟦E1⟧ was a lush place, teeming with life. But war and cataclysm raged across the land, scorching it and leaving a dry husk. Such is the way of things, and it saddens my heart.
rows.quest:870:details:1: BBut within the past few years, new oases have formed in the ⟦E1⟧, and life stirs. And deep down, we druids sense a power leaking its way to the surface.
rows.quest:870:details:2: BWe must find its source. ⟦E9⟧ to the Forgotten Pools, northwest of the Crossroads. Search its waters for a source of power, then return here.
rows.quest:870:completion:0: You found a fissure in the earth, with gases bubbling from it? Strange. This may be an answer to our questions, but we cannot yet be sure.
rows.quest:870:completion:1: BBut it is a clue. And I am grateful that you found it.
rows.quest:871:obj:0: Of the Razormane tribe, kill 8 Water Seekers, 8 Thornweavers and 3 Hunters, and then return to Thork in the Crossroads.
rows.quest:871:details:0: All the quilboars are our enemies, ⟦19⟧. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.
rows.quest:871:details:1: BThe Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply lines from ⟦E10⟧, causing us no end of annoyance. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.
rows.quest:871:details:2: BStart in the northeast towards ⟦E10⟧. You can always tell their dens from the huge thorny vines that come up from the earth. Seek them out, and slay them.
rows.quest:871:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦20⟧. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the ⟦E4⟧ is not to be ignored.
rows.quest:872:obj:0: Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders, and Kreenig Snarlsnout.
rows.quest:872:obj:1: BThen bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Thork at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:872:details:0: One of my scouts witnessed an attack on a caravan from ⟦E10⟧, ⟦21⟧. The culprits are indeed the Razormane tribe of quilboars. One of the quilboars in particular is leading the raids: Kreenig Snarlsnout. He was seen northeast of here, just south of the road from ⟦E10⟧. If the threat is to be ended, then Kreenig must die.
rows.quest:872:details:1: BTo be sure the attacks cease, though, I say we add insult to their injury. Kill Kreenig along with more of their tribe, and return to me when you have his tusk.
rows.quest:872:completion:0: Well done, ⟦22⟧. With Kreenig's death, there will be a definite decline in the attacks on our caravans.
rows.quest:872:completion:1: BYour people should be proud to count you among them.
rows.quest:873:obj:0: Bring the Heart of Isha Awak to Mahren Skyseer.
rows.quest:873:details:0: The grand Isha Awak is lord of these waters. Great is his strength, and solemn his pride. The humans on the coast fear him, for he has consumed many of their number.
rows.quest:873:details:1: BBut I do not fear him. I am grateful he is here. He is a worthy challenge, and honorable prey.
rows.quest:873:details:2: BIf you are ready, then swim out and search for Isha Awak, the Deep Doom.
rows.quest:873:details:3: BHis spirit dwells in his heart, and to hear its beat is to know your fate.
rows.quest:873:completion:0: You now are one with Isha Awak, ⟦23⟧. His spirit is with you. He lurks in your eyes...
rows.quest:873:completion:1: BEyes that, one day, will learn to see.
rows.quest:874:details:0: You have hunted the beasts of the ⟦E1⟧. Your spirit is strong. But a hunter must always be prepared. A true hunter can stalk prey down any path. Mountains and swamps will not sway ⟦24⟧.
rows.quest:874:details:2: BFind my sister, Mahren. She hunts the great water beasts along the coast. She will be your teacher in their ways.
rows.quest:874:details:3: BBut be wary in your search for her, for the ⟦E1⟧' coast is held by humans.
rows.quest:874:completion:0: My brother sent you, did he? Then you must have proven yourself to him. If you have earned the respect of Jorn, then you have my respect as well.
rows.quest:874:completion:1: BAre you ready to tread farther down the hunter's path?
rows.quest:875:obj:0: Collect 6 Harpy Lieutenant Rings from Witchwing Slayers and return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:875:details:0: Hahaha, ⟦25⟧. Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.
rows.quest:875:details:1: BThis time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.
rows.quest:875:details:2: BMake sure they die painfully, ⟦26⟧. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:875:completion:0: Excellent work my friend. I think you'll go far within the ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:876:obj:0: Slay Serena Bloodfeather and return her head to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:876:details:0: You did so well with the lieutenants and underlings that I'd like you to do one last thing for me.
rows.quest:876:details:1: BSerena Bloodfeather is the sister of a harpy named Bloodfeather who was slain by Rexxar quite a while ago. Apparently, these attacks on the ⟦E4⟧ caravans are revenge for her sister's death.
rows.quest:876:details:2: BI need you to slit her throat and bring me back her head. I want to place it on the next caravan we send out... Give those harpies something to think about.
rows.quest:876:completion:0: HA! Well done, ⟦27⟧! Very well done... I wasn't sure you were up to the task, but you've proved yourself quite the cut-throat. Thank you again for helping us suppress the Harpy epidemic. Here is your reward, use it well.
rows.quest:877:obj:0: Return to Tonga at The Crossroads, after investigating the Stagnant Oasis.
rows.quest:877:details:0: Like the one you found at the Forgotten Pools, there may be fissures at the other oases in the ⟦E1⟧. If so, then perhaps the fissures are the oases' source of life.
rows.quest:877:details:2: BHere, take these seeds. They are dead and infertile, but take them to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast. If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it...and observe.
rows.quest:877:completion:0: Your findings are amazing! The seeds I gave you were dried, and dead. Whatever rests under these oases can create life from nothing!
rows.quest:878:obj:0: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:878:details:0: You must strike my enemies. ⟦28⟧ You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. ⟦29⟧ It gives us strength in all things... especially war.
rows.quest:878:details:1: BIf you want to find out who really causes Thork ⟦30⟧ and the ⟦E4⟧ such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:878:completion:0: Yes, yes... filled with joy because finally ⟦31⟧ the Bristleback know my tribe's pain, ⟦32⟧. That is how I should feel, but that ⟦33⟧ is not the case.
rows.quest:878:completion:1: BYou aid your people and they honor you. Mangletooth aids his people, and what do they do? They turn their backs on him. They forget him and leave him to rot in cage!
rows.quest:878:completion:2: BI aid them even from locked behind bars and they send no one to save me!
rows.quest:879:obj:0: Kill Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane and bring their skulls to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:879:details:0: Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the ⟦E4⟧, ⟦34⟧. ⟦35⟧ They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the ⟦E1⟧ will learn peace... ⟦36⟧ at least from the Razormane tribe. ⟦37⟧
rows.quest:879:details:1: BNak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south of the ⟦E1⟧. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, ⟦38⟧ a warrior. Kill them, ⟦39⟧, like they have killed me.
rows.quest:879:completion:0: It is done then. Better it ends this way, says Mangletooth. ⟦40⟧ They should have ⟦41⟧ made sure I was dead when they turned their backs on me instead of leaving ⟦42⟧ me here in this forsaken cage.
rows.quest:879:completion:1: BThere is but one task left for you to finish, ⟦43⟧.
rows.quest:880:obj:0: Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:880:details:0: Your findings are incredible, ⟦44⟧. These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source. Or perhaps an inside one.
rows.quest:880:details:1: BI want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.
rows.quest:880:details:2: BHunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases. Bring me their shells so I may examine them.
rows.quest:880:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦45⟧. Studying the beasts of an area can tell much about the area itself. We shall see what tale these shells tell.
rows.quest:880:completion:1: BPlease accept my gratitude for your aid ... and perhaps you can use these coins. I find that I do not need them.
rows.quest:881:obj:0: Bring Echeyakee's Hide to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:881:details:0: Whitemist, Echeyakee in the Tauren tongue, is the king of the savannah cats. He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth. And he kills so fast his prey have no time for fear, or pain.
rows.quest:881:details:1: BThe Tauren say he is both mercy and death.
rows.quest:881:details:2: BYou will learn if that's true, for I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee. His lair is northeast of the Crossroads, among the bones of giant Kodo
rows.quest:881:details:3: BGo. Blow this horn when you reach his lair. Blow the horn, and he will come.
rows.quest:881:completion:0: You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... his spirit is with you. He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.
rows.quest:881:completion:1: BYour path is still long, ⟦46⟧. Let's hope you stride it well.
rows.quest:882:obj:0: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
rows.quest:882:details:0: Ishamuhale, Speartooth, is the fiercest sunscale raptor of the ⟦E1⟧. He does not hunt for sport, nor for food. He hunts because hunting is his passion. He kills because it is his nature to kill.
rows.quest:882:details:1: BAnd you will learn of his nature, ⟦47⟧, for your path now follows the taloned tracks of Ishamuhale.
rows.quest:882:details:2: BBegin the hunt. Slay his favorite prey, a zhevra, then bring its carcass to the dead tree northwest of Ratchet. Ishamuhale will smell the carcass and be drawn to it.
rows.quest:882:completion:0: This fang is merely a token, but what it represents is profound.
rows.quest:882:completion:1: BIshamuhale's strength is in you, ⟦48⟧. May you use it with temperance. That is your burden.
rows.quest:883:obj:0: Bring the Hoof of Lakota'mani to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
rows.quest:883:details:0: The Hoof of Lakota'mani is a symbol of the strength of the great kodo.
rows.quest:883:completion:0: Lakota'mani is called Earthshaker in our language, and his steps are like gathered thunder. He is with you now, and his courage mingles with yours. Together there is no conflict you cannot face.
rows.quest:884:obj:0: Bring Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
rows.quest:884:details:0: When touched, sparks fly from the tailspike of Owatanka.
rows.quest:884:completion:0: The thunder lizard Owatanka is called Bluebolt by the tauren, for within him resides a speed that belies his size. It is said that lightning struck Bluebolt long ago and, fed from the sky's rage, the great beast's energy is without limit.
rows.quest:884:completion:1: BMay his energy flow through you, ⟦50⟧. For you now keep pace with Owatanka.
rows.quest:885:obj:0: Bring Washte Pawne's Feather to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
rows.quest:885:details:0: The feather of Washte Pawne is painful to the touch.
rows.quest:885:completion:0: The thunderhawk is a rare beast of the ⟦E1⟧, and its death can portend great fortune, or great doom.
rows.quest:885:completion:1: BBut Washte Pawne, called Spirit Biter in Taurahe, can bring neither... or both.
rows.quest:885:completion:2: BThe pain you felt from hunting Spirit Biter is the pang all feel who make great gains at great costs. The sting you felt is the pain of regret.
rows.quest:885:completion:3: BBut I can see you have conquered this. You have learned that regret turns to wisdom, and that through pain one gains strength.
rows.quest:886:obj:0: Speak with Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:886:details:0: The druids of ⟦E3⟧ sense a strange power leaking into the ⟦E1⟧, east of ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:886:details:1: BTonga Runetotem was sent to discover the source of this power, but we fear he will need aid.
rows.quest:886:details:2: BTravel to the ⟦E1⟧ and speak with Tonga. He will be at the Crossroads. To reach there, take the road east out of Bloodhoof village. Enter the ⟦E1⟧, then turn north when the road forks. Continue north and you will find the Crossroads.
rows.quest:886:details:3: BAnd do not leave the road, ⟦52⟧, for the ⟦E1⟧ is a harsh land.
rows.quest:886:completion:0: My brethren in ⟦E3⟧ were wise to send you, young ⟦53⟧. For the mystery of the ⟦E1⟧ is one that I alone cannot unravel.
rows.quest:886:completion:1: BWith your aid, let us hope we can find answers to our questions.
rows.quest:887:obj:0: Kill 12 Southsea Brigands and 6 Southsea Cannoneers for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
rows.quest:887:details:0: I sure wish Vice Admiral Grezzlik did a better job of keeping the seas safe for our trading vessels. With all the gold the trade princes have poured into the Trade Fleets, it ticks me off to see so many pirates running willy-nilly, raiding my ships and stealing my goods!
rows.quest:887:details:1: BI heard that the Southsea Freebooters have set up a camp just south of here. They've been a real thorn in my side and if Grezzlik won't take care of them, well, maybe you can help me get rid of them.
rows.quest:887:completion:0: You did good, kid. A little more work like that, and it'll be one less thing I'll have to worry about. Hopefully they'll be convinced that they should relocate their operation elsewhere.
rows.quest:887:completion:1: BIn the meantime, there is the small matter of getting back the goods they stole from me!
rows.quest:888:obj:0: Retrieve the Shipment of Boots and Telescopic Lens for Gazlowe in Ratchet.
rows.quest:888:details:0: While I'd like to recover all my goods, I'm sure that's not possible. Still, there's a few things that I absolutely must have!
rows.quest:888:details:1: BAs you see, my observatory is ready to go, but it needs the smaller of the two lenses. The first arrived by caravan from ⟦E10⟧, but the second was bound by ship, and never arrived. Also, I never got my boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay!
rows.quest:888:details:2: BHead down to the pirate camp and see if you can find them.
rows.quest:888:completion:0: It's a relief to get all this stuff back, so thanks for your help, ⟦54⟧. You know, I could use a ⟦55⟧ like you to help out with my operation here. If you're ever looking for work, don't forget about how well Gazlowe pays for service!
